Home/Visas to Indonesia/By nationality

 Visa Service · by passport

# Indonesian visa for your passport

 01 · The pointRules follow your passportKazakhstan and Belarus have been visa-free since July 2026. Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Moldova have neither visa-free entry nor visa on arrival.

 02 · SourceOfficial registersEvery line checked against the Directorate General of Immigration lists, not against someone else's article.

 03 · Why it mattersDon't buy the ticket for nothingHalf the internet still describes visa-free entry that was abolished in August 2024.

 Updated: 27 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 Entry rules for Indonesia depend not on where you are flying from but on which passport you hold. Some nationalities can arrive with no visa at all, others simply take a visa on arrival, and for a third group it is not issued at all — the visa has to be obtained online in advance.
Below is the picture for ten countries, current as of August 2026, checked against the official registers.

## What your passport gets you

 Per the official registers of the Directorate General of Immigration, August 2026.
 Nationality | Visa-free | Visa on arrival | Max days | What to do | 

 Russia | no | yes | 60 | eVOA for 30 days plus one extension | 

 Kazakhstan | yes, 30 days | yes | 60 | a choice: visa-free, or eVOA to get the extension | 

 Belarus | yes, 30 days | yes | 60 | a choice: visa-free, or eVOA to get the extension | 

 Ukraine | no | yes | 60 | eVOA for 30 days plus one extension | 

 Uzbekistan | no | yes | 60 | eVOA for 30 days plus one extension | 

 Armenia | no | yes | 60 | eVOA for 30 days plus one extension | 

 Azerbaijan | no | yes | 60 | eVOA for 30 days plus one extension | 

 Kyrgyzstan | no | no | 180 | visa in advance only: C1 or another type | 

 Georgia | no | no | 180 | visa in advance only: C1 or another type | 

 Moldova | no | no | 180 | visa in advance only: C1 or another type | 

 None of these countries appears on the Calling Visa register — the special regime where an application is additionally cleared by the Directorate and the processing time grows. That list holds six countries: Afghanistan, Israel, North Korea, Liberia, Nigeria and Somalia.

## What changed, and why the internet is confused

 The rules moved twice in two years, and most sites are stuck on an older version.

 ✓29 August 2024. Presidential Regulation 95/2024 revoked the previous visa-free register, which covered 169 countries, and cut it to thirteen. That is when Kyrgyzstan, Georgia, Moldova and many others lost visa-free entry.

 ✓9 July 2026. Ministerial Regulation 10/2026 added six countries: Türkiye, Brazil, Peru, Kazakhstan, Macau and Belarus. The register now holds nineteen entries.

 On Kyrgyzstan specifically. The English Wikipedia and the website of the Kyrgyz Ministry of Foreign Affairs still state that Indonesia waived visas for Kyrgyz citizens back in September 2015. That stopped being true in August 2024. Someone trusting their own ministry's website will buy a ticket and not fly.

## Where other sites get it wrong

 We checked our data against the official registers and, while we were at it, checked what everyone else publishes. The result is worth knowing before you trust the first article you find.

 !Stale visa-free lists. Several large agencies show fifteen countries instead of nineteen — missing Peru, Kazakhstan, Macau and Belarus. Their pages were updated in January 2026; the regulation landed in July.

 !Errors in visa-on-arrival lists. One widely copied table omits Azerbaijan while adding Panama and San Marino, which appear on no official register at all, and Macau, which belongs to the visa-free list. It also duplicates the Maldives, Malta and Guatemala.

 !Government sites get it wrong too. The Kyrgyz foreign ministry still advertises visa-free entry abolished almost two years ago.

 We updated this page on 27 August 2026 and checked every line against the official register. Spot a discrepancy with immigration — tell us and we will verify and fix it the same day.

## Visa-free or visa on arrival: which to take

 Kazakh and Belarusian citizens have a choice — and it is less obvious than it looks.

 The two entry routes compared, for those who qualify for both.
 Parameter | Visa-free A1 | Visa on arrival B1 | 

 Duration | 30 days | 30 days | 

 Extension | not possible | once, another 30 | 

 Total days | 30 | 60 | 

 Switch to a KITAS | not allowed | yes, via a Bridging Visa | 

 Cost | free | IDR 500,000 | 

 Extension cost | — | another IDR 500,000 | 

 The logic is simple. Coming for two or three weeks — take visa-free entry, it costs nothing. Thinking of staying longer, or staying for good — take the visa on arrival from the start, because from visa-free entry you cannot switch to any other status at all: only fly out and come back.

## What everyone needs, without exception

 ✓A passport valid for at least 6 months on the date of entry

 ✓A return or onward ticket — asked for at check-in and at the border

 ✓The Arrival Card — filed online at allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id no earlier than three days before departure

 ✓The Bali tourist levy of IDR 150,000 — paid separately on the provincial portal

 An important document restriction. Visa-free entry is not available to stateless persons or to holders of temporary, emergency or non-national travel documents. If what you hold is a certificate of identity or a travel document rather than an ordinary passport, visa-free entry will not work — you need a visa.

## What comes next if you want to stay

 None of these ten nationalities faces restrictions on long-term status. The only difference is where you start from.

 ✓From a visa on arrival you can move to a KITAS, but only through an intermediate Bridging Visa

 ✓From a C1 visa the conversion is direct, with no intermediate step

 ✓From visa-free entry you cannot switch at all — you will have to fly out and come back

 ✓Working for a foreign company — look at the E33G remote worker KITAS: nationality is irrelevant, income from USD 60,000 a year is what counts

## Careful: a scam runs around the payment step

 Barely anyone writes about this, and everyone filing an application themselves should know it. Since spring 2026 a scheme has been running around electronic visa payments, and it is smarter than ordinary spam.

 !The scammers hold your real application data — your name and reference number. The email reads as a continuation of your correspondence with immigration, because it arrives interleaved with genuine ones.

 !They ask you to "top up" — for the arrival card, for completing the file, for faster processing. The link leads to a third-party site, sometimes to a crypto service asking you to open a wallet.

 !They target people whose payment failed. If the payment on the official portal has stalled, you are already anxious and more willing to trust an email saying "pay here".

 One simple rule. A visa can only be paid for inside your own session on evisa.imigrasi.go.id. Never through a link in an email — even if it arrives from the right address and knows your reference number. Immigration does not request top-up payments after filing.

## Do you need a sponsor?

 Another myth people charge money for: that citizens of CIS countries need a local sponsor for an ordinary visa. They do not.

 In the immigration application system each country carries a technical flag for "guarantor required". It is set for exactly five states: Bangladesh, Cameroon, Guinea, Iran and Yemen. No CIS country carries it — their citizens file for a C1 and other visit visas on their own.

 On Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Moldova specifically: having no visa on arrival is not a ban. All three are present in the online application system and their citizens obtain ordinary visas in the usual way — just in advance, rather than at an airport desk.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: Is a police clearance certificate required?
No. In the official immigration requirements for C1, C2, work, investor, family and retirement visas, a police clearance certificate is not mentioned once. Some agencies claim otherwise — that is their own precaution, not a legal requirement.

Вопрос: Why is my card being declined on the immigration portal?
The portal accepts payment through SIMPONI, the Indonesian state payment system, or by Mastercard, Visa and JCB. MIR, UnionPay and American Express are not listed — the issue is card acceptance, not your passport. Worth knowing separately: the portal's payment gateway fails for everyone regardless of nationality. People report money leaving the account while the application never updates, or one card failing where another goes through. Through an agency the fee is settled from the Indonesian side and this step simply disappears.

Вопрос: Can a Kazakh citizen take the visa on arrival instead of entering visa-free?
Legally yes: Kazakhstan and Belarus appear on both official registers. The safer route is to arrange the eVOA online before departure — then the question never arises at the border, and you get 30 days with the right to extend by another 30.

Вопрос: What happens if you fly in without a visa you were not entitled to skip?
The airline will most likely stop you at boarding — it checks entry eligibility and pays a fine for carrying a passenger without documents. If you do land, you are turned around at the border at your own expense. Which is why this is checked before buying the ticket, not after.

Вопрос: How much does overstaying cost?
IDR 1,000,000 per day, per person. Beyond 60 days it is no longer a fine but deportation with an entry ban. Full breakdown in our article on overstaying in Bali.

 Tell us your nationality and how long you plan to stay — we will say what is available to you specifically, and arrange it end to end.

## How it works
The finder is built on the rules as they stand: permitted stay for each visa index, how many extensions each allows, and the limits tied to your purpose. It does not replace a consultation — but in half a minute it shows which direction to look in and what it costs.
The thing to remember: you choose before you fly. You cannot move from an e-VOA to a C1 once you are in the country, and from visa-free entry you cannot move to anything at all.

## What the recommendations rest on
e-VOA — 30 days plus one 30-day extension. A 60-day ceiling, with no second extension
C1 — 60 days plus two 60-day extensions. A ceiling of 180 consecutive days
D1 and D2 — a 1–2 year visa; each entry gives 60 days, extendable to 180 per visit
Visa-free — exactly 30 days, no extension and no switch to a KITAS
KITAS — a year or more, chosen by where your income comes from: E33G, work, investor or family
Official extension fees: 30 days — IDR 500,000; 60 days — IDR 2,000,000; 180 days — IDR 6,000,000. Filed no later than the day your current permit ends.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How accurate is the finder?
It works from the official terms and limits for each visa type, but it does not know the specifics of your case: calling-visa nationalities, your travel history, your family situation. Treat the result as a starting point, not a final decision.

Вопрос: Can I change visa once I am in Bali?
From a visit permit — an e-VOA or C1 — a change of status to a KITAS is provided for. You cannot move from an e-VOA to a C1 inside the country. From visa-free entry you can neither extend nor change status.

Вопрос: What if my trip runs longer than planned?
On an e-VOA the ceiling is 60 days and then you must leave. On a C1 it is 180. Building in headroom is cheaper than changing plans later: an overstay costs IDR 1,000,000 per day, per person.

Вопрос: Do I need a sponsor?
The C1, C2, D1 and D2 all require one. For our clients we act as the sponsor, so there is no one for you to find.

Twice, 60 days each, for up to 180 days of stay including the initial permit.

 Visa Extension · D12

# Extension of the D12 Pre-Investment visa

 01 · Gives you+180 daysUp to 360 days per visit including the initial permit.
02 · PriceIDR 5,000,000All-in, government fee included.
03 · CompanyNot requiredWe extend for people whose PT PMA is still only a plan.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 D12 is the visa for preparing a business in Indonesia: market research, negotiations, finding premises. Each visit gives up to 180 days, and inside the visit the stay extends by a further 180 — up to 360 days per entry.
The extension is IDR 5,000,000 all-in, with the government fee inside.

## How the clock runs

 Stay on a D12 visa per visit, August 2026.
 Stage | Days | Total per visit | All-in price | 

 Arrival: initial permit | 180 | 180 | included in the visa | 

 Onshore extension | +180 | 360 | IDR 5,000,000 | 

 Or leave and re-enter | 180 | the count restarts | free, the visa stays valid | 

 No company needed to extend: a D12 is extended even when the PT PMA is still only a plan. What does matter is using the visa for its stated purpose — preparing an investment, not living on the island.

 Extend via WhatsAppExtend via Telegram

## Where the route leads

 D12 is designed as a preparation stage, not a permanent status. Working and earning income in Indonesia are not permitted on it.

 The standard path is D12 → register a PT PMA → investor KITAS. Once the company exists, moving to a KITAS settles the question of extensions for two years ahead.

## Biometrics are mandatory

 Since June 2025 every extension requires you in person: a photograph, fingerprints and a short interview.

 Everything else — documents, filing, fees, tracking — is ours. Offices in Bali: Denpasar, Ngurah Rai (Jimbaran) and Singaraja.

## Gili, Lombok, Nusa Penida: no need to fly to Bali

 Extensions are filed online, so where you are staying does not affect the application. We handle clients on Gili, Lombok and Nusa Penida, and in Jakarta and Surabaya, exactly as on Bali.

 The only part tied to a location is biometrics: you attend the office covering your area. Nusa Penida has no office of its own, so people travel to Denpasar.

## How the extension works

 We check your caseWe look at the visa type, expiry date and extensions used, and say straight away if extending is not possible.

 We prepare and fileWe assemble the package, submit, pay the fees and follow it to a decision.

 You attend biometricsWe tell you the office, date and time. About half an hour.

 You get the approvalIt arrives as a notification. We set a reminder for the next deadline.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: Will a D12 be extended without a registered company?
Yes. A registered PT PMA is not required to extend a D12 — we extend for people whose company is still only a plan. What does matter is using the visa for its stated purpose: preparing an investment and negotiating, rather than simply living on the island.

Вопрос: How many times can a D12 be extended?
Once, for 180 days inside a visit. Together with the initial permit that gives up to 360 days per entry, while the visa itself remains valid for one or two years.

Вопрос: How much does a D12 extension cost?
IDR 5,000,000 all-in. The government stay-permit fee is already inside that figure.

Вопрос: Can I just leave instead of extending?
Yes. D12 is multiple-entry, so departure does not cancel it: after a new arrival you get another 180 days. Sometimes that beats the extension on price — it depends on the fare.

Вопрос: How is D12 different from an investor KITAS?
D12 is a preparation stage: exploring the market, negotiating, setting the business up. It does not allow you to work or earn income. Once the company is running, an investor KITAS E28A replaces it and removes the extension question for two years.

Вопрос: What if I miss the deadline?
An expired permit cannot be extended. The fine is IDR 1,000,000 per day, per person, so message us as soon as you notice — the earlier we start, the smaller the exposure.

 Visa Extension · VOA / eVOA

# Visa on arrival extension (VOA / eVOA)

 01 · Gives you+30 daysOne extension only — 60 days of stay in total.
02 · PriceIDR 950,000All-in, with the IDR 500,000 government fee inside.
03 · Your partOne visitBiometrics at the office. Filing and fees are ours.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 A visa on arrival is extended exactly once, for a further 30 days. It is the most common extension in Bali and the simplest: the application is filed online, and all you do is attend the immigration office once for biometrics.
Our all-in price is IDR 950,000, with the IDR 500,000 government fee already inside. We file the application, pay the fee, handle correspondence with immigration and book your appointment.

## How many days the extension gives

 Stay on a visa on arrival, August 2026.
 Stage | Days | Running total | 

 Initial VOA / eVOA permit | 30 | 30 | 

 Extension (one only) | +30 | 60 | 

 Bridging visa, if you need longer | +60 | 120 | 

 After 60 days the usual route is leaving the country. If you would rather not fly, a bridging visa adds 60 days on the spot.

## Two deadlines you cannot mix up

 No earlier than 14 days before the current permit expires — the system will not take it sooner

 No later than the day the permit expires
Processing takes up to 3 working days after payment clears

 The detail that matters: overstay does not accrue if payment cleared before the current permit expired, even when the office visit happens later. Pay a few working days ahead, not on the final day.

## Gili, Lombok, Nusa Penida: no need to fly to Bali

 Extensions are filed online, so where you are staying does not affect the application. We handle clients on Gili, Lombok and Nusa Penida, and in Jakarta and Surabaya, exactly as we do on Bali.

## How the extension works

 We check your caseWe look at the visa type, the expiry date and how many extensions you have used, and say straight away if extending is not possible.

 We prepare and fileWe assemble the package, submit the application, pay the government fees and follow it to a decision.

 You attend biometricsWe tell you the office, date and time. The visit takes about half an hour.

 You get the approvalThe extension arrives as a notification. We set a reminder for the next deadline.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How many times can a visa on arrival be extended?
Once, for 30 days. Total stay on a VOA is therefore 60 days at most: 30 days of the initial permit plus a 30-day extension. There is no second extension on this visa.

Вопрос: How much does an eVOA extension cost?
IDR 950,000 all-in. The government fee of IDR 500,000 is already inside that figure — nothing more to pay at the office.

Вопрос: How early should I file?
No earlier than 14 days before the current permit expires — the system will not accept it sooner. And no later than the day it expires. Processing takes up to 3 working days after payment.

Вопрос: Will I be fined if my office visit falls after the visa expires?
No. Overstay does not accrue as long as payment cleared before the current permit expired, even if the biometrics appointment is later. That is why you should pay a few working days ahead, not on the final day.

Вопрос: Will my passport be held?
The stay permit is electronic, so in the vast majority of cases your passport stays with you — it is only needed at the biometrics appointment itself.

Вопрос: Do I have to visit the immigration office?
Yes, once, for a photo and fingerprints. Biometrics have been mandatory for every extension since June 2025. The application, payment and correspondence are ours.

Вопрос: What happens when the 60 days are up?
Either leave and return on a new visa, or stay and arrange a bridging visa, which adds another 60 days without a flight. If your plans are longer, move to a C1 tourist visa for up to 180 days or to a yearly KITAS.

# Family KITAS E31 extension

 01 · Gives you+1 yearAnnual extension without leaving the country.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 A family KITAS is extended annually and without leaving the country. The key feature is that it is a dependent status: it lasts exactly as long as the sponsor's status does.
Our all-in price is IDR 12,000,000 per person per year, government fees included.

## Price and term

 Family KITAS E31 extension, August 2026.
 Who sponsors | Status validity | All-in price | Departure needed | 

 Spouse — an Indonesian citizen | 1 year | IDR 12,000,000 | no | 

 Spouse — a KITAS or KITAP holder | runs to the sponsor document | IDR 12,000,000 | no | 

 Child up to and including 17 | runs to the sponsor | IDR 12,000,000 | no | 

 Each family member is filed separately, so a family of three means three procedures.

 Extend via WhatsAppExtend via Telegram

## Order matters more than speed

 Dependent statuses follow the sponsor. If the sponsor holds a KITAS, their status is extended first and the family statuses after. Getting the order wrong opens a gap for the whole family.

 We run both procedures in parallel and time the dates so no window opens between them. If your spouse holds an E33G or an investor KITAS, we extend them together.

## When a child turns 18

 A family KITAS covers children up to and including 17. After that a status of their own is required — student, work or another, depending on the case. Start looking a few months before the birthday so nobody is left without status.

## When to start

 A month before the current status expires. The formal condition is that at least 30 days must remain on the KITAS.

 Important: an expired KITAS cannot be extended — the status is closed through EPO and a new one arranged from scratch.

## Biometrics are mandatory

 Since June 2025 every extension requires you in person: a photograph, fingerprints and a short interview.

 Everything else — documents, filing, fees, tracking — is ours. Offices in Bali: Denpasar, Ngurah Rai (Jimbaran) and Singaraja.

## Gili, Lombok, Nusa Penida: no need to fly to Bali

 Extensions are filed online, so where you are staying does not affect the application. We handle clients on Gili, Lombok and Nusa Penida, and in Jakarta and Surabaya, exactly as on Bali.

 The only part tied to a location is biometrics: you attend the office covering your area. Nusa Penida has no office of its own, so people travel to Denpasar.

## How the extension works

 We check the statusWe look at the KITAS type, expiry date and the basis it rests on.

 We collect documentsWe prepare the package from you and the sponsor, file and pay the fees.

 You attend biometricsWe tell you the office, date and time. About half an hour.

 You get the new termThe extended status arrives as a notification, with a reminder set for next time.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How much does a family KITAS extension cost?
IDR 12,000,000 all-in for a year, government fees included. Each family member is filed separately.

Вопрос: How long is the extension for?
A year, when the sponsor is an Indonesian citizen. If the sponsor holds a KITAS or KITAP, the dependent status runs to the sponsor document and is extended together with it.

Вопрос: Do I need to leave the country?
No, the extension happens inside Indonesia.

Вопрос: Up to what age can a child stay on a family KITAS?
Up to and including 17. After that a status of their own is needed — a student, work or other status depending on the case.

Вопрос: Can I work on a family KITAS?
No, a family KITAS does not grant the right to work in Indonesia. Employment requires a work KITAS from the employing company.

Вопрос: What if the sponsor is a spouse whose own KITAS is extended later?
Dependent statuses follow the sponsor, so the order matters: the sponsor KITAS is extended first, the dependents after. We run both procedures and make sure no gap opens between them.

 01 · What we extendEvery typeeVOA, C1 tourist, C2 business, D1/D2 multiple-entry, D12 and every KITAS.

03 · Your partBiometrics onlyDocuments, filing and fees are on us. You visit the office once for a photo and fingerprints.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 Extending is the most common immigration procedure in Bali. Almost every Indonesian visa can be extended, but each has its own ceiling: how many times, for how many days, and up to what total. Getting it wrong is expensive — overstaying costs IDR 1,000,000 per day, per person.
We run the extension end to end: we check your case, prepare and file the paperwork, pay the government fees and watch the deadlines. All you do is show up once at the immigration office for biometrics — that part is required by law and cannot be delegated.

## What can be extended, and by how much

 Extension limits by visa type, August 2026.
 Visa | Extensions allowed | Each extension | Maximum stay | 

 eVOA / VOA (B1) | one | +30 days | 60 days | 

 C1 tourist | two | +60 days | 180 days | 

 C2 business | two | +60 days | 180 days | 

 D1 / D2 multiple-entry | within each entry | up to 180 days per visit | 1–2 years of visa validity | 

 D12 Pre-Investment | one | +180 days | 1–2 years of visa validity | 

 KITAS (all types) | annually | +1 year | depends on the status | 

 Once the limit is used up, the visa is replaced rather than extended: either leave and re-enter on a new one, or switch status inside the country through a bridging visa.

 Count the cost of the time, not the cost of the extension. One C1 extension usually beats a flight out and back, and a yearly KITAS often works out cheaper than four extensions in a row. Not sure which route is cheaper for you — run it through the visa finder.

## Biometrics: one visit you cannot skip

 Since June 2025 every visa or stay-permit extension requires you to appear in person: a photograph, fingerprints and a short interview. This is an immigration requirement and no agency can do it for you.

 Everything else is ours: preparing documents, filing the application, paying fees, tracking the status and collecting the approval. You just turn up on the assigned day.

 Offices in Bali: Denpasar, Ngurah Rai (Jimbaran) and Singaraja. Details are in our guide to Bali immigration offices.

## What we need from you

 A photo of the full passport spread

 A personal photo

 Your ITK or entry sticker — or the entry date, if you came through the autogates

 Marital status

 Email and a WhatsApp or Telegram contact

 If we arranged your visa, your data is already on file — just send a photo of the sticker or your entry date. If the passport or entry stamp is damaged, immigration may refuse the extension.

## How the extension works

 We check your caseWe look at the visa type, the expiry date and how many extensions you have already used, and tell you straight away if an extension is not possible.

 We prepare and fileWe assemble the package, complete the application, pay the government fees and submit it to immigration.

 You attend biometricsWe tell you the office, date and time. The visit takes about half an hour.

 You get the approvalThe extension arrives as a notification. We set a reminder for the next deadline so you never slip into overstay.

## When to file, and what overstaying costs

 File one to two weeks before your current stay ends. Filing at the last moment is risky: if immigration asks for an extra document, there is no time left to answer.

 Overstaying costs IDR 1,000,000 per day, per person, children included. Up to 60 days the fine is usually settled on departure. Beyond 60 days the consequences are heavier: deportation and an entry ban. What to do if your stay has already lapsed is covered in our overstay guide, and you can work out the amount in the fine calculator.

## When you run out of extensions

 Once the limit is reached, there are two routes. Leave the country and return on a new visa, or switch status inside Indonesia through a bridging visa: it adds up to 60 days beyond the standard 30+30 on an eVOA and lets you change visa type without leaving.

 If you come to Bali regularly, extending in circles is rarely the cheapest option — a multiple-entry D1 or D2 or a yearly KITAS E33G usually works out better.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How much does a Bali visa extension cost?
It depends on the visa: eVOA IDR 950,000, C1 tourist IDR 2,500,000 (3,500,000 rush), C2 business IDR 2,800,000, D1/D2 multiple-entry IDR 2,600,000 (3,100,000 rush), D12 IDR 5,000,000. Annual KITAS: E33G and retirement IDR 12,000,000 each, work 15,000,000, investor 17,000,000 for two years, family and student 12,000,000. All-in prices with government fees included.

Вопрос: Can a visa be extended without showing up in person?
No. Since June 2025 biometrics are mandatory for every extension: a photo, fingerprints and a short interview at an immigration office. We handle everything else, but you attend biometrics yourself.

Вопрос: How far in advance should I file?
One to two weeks before the current stay ends. That leaves room if immigration requests an extra document. Filing on the final day does not work — the application will not clear in time.

Вопрос: Will my passport be held during the extension?
Stay permits are electronic now, so in most cases the passport stays with you. If your visa type needs a sticker, we tell you in advance.

Вопрос: What does overstaying a visa in Indonesia cost?
The fine is IDR 1,000,000 per day, per person. Up to 60 days it is usually settled on departure; beyond that, deportation and an entry ban are possible. Message us straight away — the sooner we start, the smaller the amount and the risk.

Вопрос: Can I leave the country while the extension is being processed?
No. While the application is pending you cannot leave Indonesia: departure cancels the procedure, and on a single-entry visa it cancels the visa too.

Вопрос: How many times in a row can I extend?
It depends on the visa: eVOA extends once, C1 and C2 twice, D12 once for 180 days, and a KITAS is extended annually within its own type. When the limit runs out you need to leave or switch status through a bridging visa.

# Investor KITAS E28A extension

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 An investor KITAS is extended for two years at a time and does not require leaving the country. For PT PMA owners it is the most convenient status: one procedure settles things for a long stretch, and you can work in your own company without a separate work permit.
Our all-in price is IDR 17,000,000 for two years, government fees included.

## Price and timing

 Investor KITAS E28A extension, August 2026.
 What we do | Status validity | All-in price | Departure needed | 

 Extend a valid KITAS | 2 years | IDR 17,000,000 | no | 

 First-time filing, offshore | 2 years | IDR 17,000,000 | you are outside the country | 

 First-time filing, onshore via bridging | 2 years | IDR 21,000,000 | no | 

 The IDR 4,000,000 difference for onshore filing is the bridging visa, the interim status for switching without a flight.

 Extend via WhatsAppExtend via Telegram

## What immigration checks

 Extending an investor status is less about you than about the company. They look at whether the PT PMA is active, whether you are still listed as shareholder, director or commissioner, and whether reporting has been filed.

 If the company has neglected its reporting, the extension is exactly where it turns into an urgent problem. We handle PT PMA accounting and check the company's standing before filing, so you do not run into a refusal.

## When to start

 A month before the current status expires. The formal condition is that at least 30 days must remain on the KITAS.

 Important: an expired KITAS cannot be extended — the status is closed through EPO and a new one arranged from scratch. We set a reminder as soon as the status is issued.

## Biometrics are mandatory

 Since June 2025 every extension requires you in person: a photograph, fingerprints and a short interview.

 Everything else — documents, filing, fees, tracking — is ours. Offices in Bali: Denpasar, Ngurah Rai (Jimbaran) and Singaraja.

## Gili, Lombok, Nusa Penida: no need to fly to Bali

 Extensions are filed online, so where you are staying does not affect the application. We handle clients on Gili, Lombok and Nusa Penida, and in Jakarta and Surabaya, exactly as on Bali.

 The only part tied to a location is biometrics: you attend the office covering your area. Nusa Penida has no office of its own, so people travel to Denpasar.

## How the extension works

 We check the statusWe look at the KITAS type, expiry date and the basis it rests on, and say straight away if conditions have changed.

 We collect documentsWe prepare the package from you and the sponsor, file the application and pay the government fees.

 You attend biometricsWe tell you the office, date and time. About half an hour.

 You get the new termThe extended status arrives as a notification. We set a reminder for the next deadline.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How much does an investor KITAS extension cost?
IDR 17,000,000 all-in for two years, government fees included.

Вопрос: How long is the extension for?
Two years. That beats the annual statuses: one procedure settles the question two years ahead.

Вопрос: Do I need to leave the country?
No, a valid investor KITAS is extended inside Indonesia.

Вопрос: What is checked at extension?
That the company is alive and you are still a shareholder, director or commissioner: current incorporation documents, proof of your stake, and PT PMA reporting. If the company has not filed its reports, this is where it surfaces.

Вопрос: Can I work for another company on an investor KITAS?
No. The status covers managing only the company it was issued on. Employment elsewhere requires a work KITAS from that employer.

Вопрос: What comes after several extensions?
Continuous status opens the path to a KITAP, permanent residence. The conditions depend on your stay history — message us and we will map it.

 A KITAS E33G is extended for another year and does not require leaving the country. That is the main difference between residence status and visit visas: no 60-day segments to count and no visa runs to plan.
The extension is IDR 12,000,000 all-in per year, government fees inside.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: Is it true that an E33G cannot be extended and must be closed through EPO?
No — this is a common misconception, and both claims still circulate online. A valid E33G is extended for another year inside the country, without leaving and without closing the status. EPO applies to a different case: closing a KITAS for good, or when the deadline has already passed and there is nothing left to extend.

Вопрос: How much does an E33G extension cost?
IDR 12,000,000 all-in for a year, with government fees included.

Вопрос: Do I need to leave the country to extend?
No. Extending a valid E33G happens inside Indonesia. Leaving is only needed when the status has already lapsed and a new one is being arranged.

Вопрос: What does it cost to move onto an E33G from an eVOA or C1?
IDR 16,000,000 onshore — that is the conversion through a bridging visa. From a C1 the conversion runs directly; from an eVOA there is no direct route, only the interim status.

Вопрос: When should I start the extension?
A month before the current KITAS expires. At least 30 days must remain on the status — later than that is too late to file.

Вопрос: What if I miss the deadline?
An expired KITAS cannot be extended: the status has to be closed via EPO and a new one arranged from scratch, which takes longer and costs more. We set a reminder as soon as the status is issued.

 Visa Extension · D1 / D2

# Multiple-entry extension D1 and D2

 01 · Gives you+60 daysTwice per visit — up to 180 days from arrival.
02 · PriceIDR 2,600,000All-in. Rush — IDR 3,100,000.
03 · The visaSurvivesDeparture does not cancel it: a new arrival means fresh 60 days.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 Multiple-entry visas follow their own logic: what gets extended is the stay inside a given entry, not the visa. The visa runs for one or two years, entries are unlimited, and every arrival starts a fresh 60 days.
Within one visit the stay can be extended twice by 60 days — up to 180 days per arrival. Our all-in price is IDR 2,600,000 when filed ahead and IDR 3,100,000 on short notice.

## How the clock runs inside one entry

 Stay on a D1 / D2 per visit, August 2026.
 Stage | Days | Total per visit | All-in price | 

 Arrival: initial permit | 60 | 60 | included in the visa | 

 First extension | +60 | 120 | 2,600,000 · 3,100,000 rush | 

 Second extension | +60 | 180 | 2,600,000 · 3,100,000 rush | 

 Leave and re-enter | 60 | the count restarts | free, the visa stays valid | 

 The official fee per 60-day extension is IDR 2,000,000 and is already inside our price. Departure does not cancel the visa — the key difference from single-entry C1 and C2.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How does a multiple-entry D1 or D2 extension work?
You extend the stay inside a specific entry, not the visa itself. Each visit gives 60 days plus two 60-day extensions — up to 180 days per arrival. The visa itself stays valid for one or two years.

Вопрос: How much does a D1 or D2 extension cost?
IDR 2,600,000 when filed 6 or more working days before expiry, and IDR 3,100,000 on shorter notice. All-in prices; the official IDR 2,000,000 fee per 60 days is already inside.

Вопрос: Does leaving the country cancel the visa?
No, and that is its main advantage. D1 and D2 are multiple-entry: you return on the same visa and get a fresh 60 days from the date of arrival.

Вопрос: Is it cheaper to extend or to fly out?
It depends on the fare. An extension costs IDR 2,600,000 for 60 days, so if tickets are cheaper than that, leaving may win. An extension saves two travel days and needs no new booking.

Вопрос: Do I need a sponsor to extend a D1 or D2?
Yes, and we provide the sponsorship. You do not need to find an Indonesian company yourself, even if another agency issued the visa.

Вопрос: Can I work on a D1 or D2?
No. Both are visit visas and do not grant the right to work or earn income in Indonesia.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How much does a retirement KITAS extension cost?
IDR 12,000,000 all-in for a year, government fees included.

Вопрос: How many years can it be extended for?
The retirement status is extended annually, up to five years in total. After that a different route is needed — for example a KITAP, which on the retirement line opens at 60.

Вопрос: Do I need to leave the country to extend?
No, the extension happens inside Indonesia.

Вопрос: Are a rental agreement and medical insurance required?
No. Those requirements appear in older material and belong to the discontinued Retirement Visa regime. They are not part of the current rules.

Вопрос: What income has to be proven?
From USD 3,000 a month — a pension, rental income or another regular source — plus a three-month bank statement with a balance from USD 2,000.

Вопрос: Is a sponsor required?
Yes, a licensed agency acts as sponsor: this status cannot be arranged or extended on your own. We sponsor our own clients.

 Visa Extension · C1 / 211A

# Tourist visa extension C1 / 211A

 01 · Gives you+60 daysEach extension adds 60 days to your current permit.
02 · ExtensionsTwoTotal stay reaches 180 days.
03 · Pricefrom IDR 2,500,000All-in, fees included. Rush — IDR 3,500,000.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 A C1 tourist visa gives 60 days from entry and extends twice by 60 days each — up to 180 days in the country. It is the standard way to spend half a year in Bali without leaving.
Each extension is filed and paid for separately: IDR 2,500,000 over 10 working days, or IDR 3,500,000 in 5–6.

## How the 180 days add up

 Stay on a C1 visa, August 2026.
 Stage | Days | Total | All-in price | 

 Initial permit on entry | 60 | 60 | included in the visa | 

 First extension | +60 | 120 | 2,500,000 · 3,500,000 rush | 

 Second extension | +60 | 180 | 2,500,000 · 3,500,000 rush | 

 There is no third extension. After that: leave, or move to a KITAS — from a C1 the conversion is direct, with no bridging visa required.

 Extend via WhatsAppExtend via Telegram

## Biometrics are mandatory

 Since June 2025 every extension requires you to appear in person: a photograph, fingerprints and a short interview. No agency can do this part for you.

 Everything else — documents, filing, fees, status tracking — is ours. Offices in Bali: Denpasar, Ngurah Rai (Jimbaran) and Singaraja.

## What we need from you

 A photo of the full passport spread
A personal photo

 Your ITK or entry sticker — or the entry date, if you used the autogates

 Marital status

## Gili, Lombok, Nusa Penida: no need to fly to Bali

 Extensions are filed online, so where you are staying does not affect the application. We handle clients on Gili, Lombok and Nusa Penida, and in Jakarta and Surabaya, exactly as we do on Bali.

 The only part tied to a location is biometrics: you attend the immigration office that covers your area. Nusa Penida has no office of its own, so people travel to Denpasar. Tell us where you are and we will find the nearest office and book a convenient slot.

## How the extension works

 You get the approvalThe extension arrives as a notification. We set a reminder for the next deadline.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How is C1 different from a 211A visa — are they the same thing?
They are the same visa. 211A is the old designation and C1 is the current one. Both names are still in circulation, so a visa issued as a "211A" extends exactly like a C1.

Вопрос: How many times can a C1 tourist visa be extended?
Twice, 60 days each time. Counting the initial permit, total stay reaches 180 days. After that it cannot be extended — you need to leave or move to another status.

Вопрос: How much does a C1 extension cost?
IDR 2,500,000 with 10 working days of processing, or IDR 3,500,000 for a rush job in 5–6 working days. All-in prices, government fees included. Each of the two extensions is paid for separately.

Вопрос: Do I need a new sponsor if another agency issued the visa?
No, the sponsor does not need to change. We extend visas issued anywhere — send a photo of the sticker in your passport or your entry date and we will find the record.

Вопрос: Can I leave the country while on a C1?
No. C1 is single-entry: leaving cancels it and you cannot return on it. If you travel often, a multiple-entry D1 or D2 fits better.

Вопрос: What happens after 180 days?
Leave and return on a new visa, or move to a KITAS. A useful advantage of C1: conversion to a KITAS E33G runs directly, with no intermediate bridging visa.

 Status Extension · E23

# Work KITAS E23 extension

 01 · Gives you+1 yearAnother year of status, without leaving the country.
02 · PriceIDR 15,000,000All-in. DKP-TKA of USD 1,200 is paid by the employer.
03 · Timing7–9 working daysFile no later than 30 days before the status expires.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 A work KITAS is extended for another year without leaving the country, and the extension itself is quick — 7–9 working days. The long timelines you see online belong to first-time filing and to changing employer, where the RPTKA has to be approved again.
Our all-in price is IDR 15,000,000 for a year. The employer separately pays the DKP-TKA state levy.

## Price and timing

 Work KITAS E23 extension, August 2026.
 What we do | Status validity | Our all-in price | DKP-TKA levy | Processing time | 

 Extend a valid KITAS | 1 year | IDR 15,000,000 | USD 1,200 | 7–9 working days | 

 First-time filing, offshore | 1 year | IDR 17,000,000 | USD 1,200 | 30–45 working days | 

 First-time filing, onshore via bridging | 1 year | IDR 21,000,000 | USD 1,200 | 30–45 working days | 

 DKP-TKA (Dana Kompensasi Penggunaan Tenaga Kerja Asing) is the state levy for employing a foreigner: USD 100 per month, USD 1,200 a year, paid upfront. Older sources call it DPKK. The employer pays it; it is not in our price. Not to be confused with RPTKA, which is the utilisation plan rather than a payment.

 Extend via WhatsAppExtend via Telegram

## What gets extended alongside your status

 A work KITAS has a dual nature: it is tied both to you and to the sponsoring company. While the employer stays the same, the extension takes the short route — 7–9 working days. It only becomes slow when the pairing of worker and company itself changes.

 Changing employer is not an extension. A valid KITAS cannot be moved to a different company: a new RPTKA, a new DKP-TKA and a new status are arranged instead. Plan the move ahead — it takes 30–45 working days.

## When to start

 A month before the current status expires. The formal condition is that at least 30 days must remain on the KITAS.

 Important: an expired KITAS cannot be extended — the status is closed through EPO and a new one arranged from scratch. We set a reminder as soon as the status is issued.

## Biometrics are mandatory

 Since June 2025 every extension requires you in person: a photograph, fingerprints and a short interview.

 Everything else — documents, filing, fees, tracking — is ours. Offices in Bali: Denpasar, Ngurah Rai (Jimbaran) and Singaraja.

## Gili, Lombok, Nusa Penida: no need to fly to Bali

 Extensions are filed online, so where you are staying does not affect the application. We handle clients on Gili, Lombok and Nusa Penida, and in Jakarta and Surabaya, exactly as on Bali.

 The only part tied to a location is biometrics: you attend the office covering your area. Nusa Penida has no office of its own, so people travel to Denpasar.

## How the extension works

 We check the statusWe look at the KITAS type, expiry date and the basis it rests on, and say straight away if conditions have changed.

 We collect documentsWe prepare the package from you and the sponsor, file the application and pay the government fees.

 You attend biometricsWe tell you the office, date and time. About half an hour.

 You get the new termThe extended status arrives as a notification. We set a reminder for the next deadline.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How long does a work KITAS extension take?
7–9 working days. That is markedly faster than first-time filing, which runs 30–45 working days because the RPTKA has to be approved again at the Ministry of Manpower. Extending with the same employer skips that stage.

Вопрос: How much does a work KITAS extension cost?
IDR 15,000,000 all-in for a year. Separately the employer pays the DKP-TKA state levy — USD 100 per month, so USD 1,200 for the year, upfront.

Вопрос: What is DKP-TKA and who pays it?
DKP-TKA (Dana Kompensasi Penggunaan Tenaga Kerja Asing) is the state compensation levy for employing a foreign worker; older sources call it DPKK. The employer pays it and it is not part of our price. Do not confuse it with RPTKA — that is the foreign worker utilisation plan approved by the Ministry of Manpower, not a payment.

Вопрос: Do I need to leave the country to extend?
No, a valid work KITAS is extended inside Indonesia. Leaving is only needed when the status has lapsed and a new one is being arranged.

Вопрос: What happens if I change employer?
A KITAS cannot be transferred to another company. Changing employer means arranging the permits and status again from scratch: a new RPTKA, a new DKP-TKA and a new KITAS. Start early — the process takes 30–45 working days.

Вопрос: When should I file?
A month before the status expires. The extension itself takes 7–9 working days, but the margin covers a request for an extra document from immigration.

Вопрос: Can I take side work at other companies?
No. A work KITAS only allows employment at the sponsoring company. Freelancing and side jobs for other companies are not permitted on this status.

 Visa Service · VOA / eVOA

# Visa on Arrival (VOA)

 01 · Duration30 + 30 daysIssued for 30 days, extendable once for another 30 — up to 60 in total.
02 · SimpleAt the airport or onlineIssued at the counter before passport control — or arranged in advance as an eVOA.
03 · With usExtension without queuesWe handle the extension — no immigration-office visits in the middle of your holiday.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 VOA is the fastest way into Indonesia for a short trip: holidays, business meetings, shopping or transit. Get it right at the arrival airport or in advance online (eVOA) — no embassies, no waiting.
It is single entry: leaving the country cancels the visa. If your plans stretch beyond 60 days, look at the C1 tourist visa for up to 180.

## Key terms
Valid for 30 days from entry
One extension for another 30 days — 60 days maximum
Government extension fee — 500,000 IDR; turnkey with us — 950,000 IDR
Single entry: exiting Indonesia cancels the visa
Covers tourism, business meetings, shopping and transit
Note: a VOA does not permit working or earning income in Indonesia.

## Required documents
Passport valid at least 6 months from the date of entry
A return or onward ticket
A personal photo and card details — for arranging an eVOA online

## Who can get a visa on arrival

 A visa on arrival is issued to nationals of 97 countries. The list is closed: if your country is not on it, an eVOA cannot be arranged online or at the airport — you need a visa obtained in advance.

 Official register of the Directorate General of Immigration, August 2026.
 Region | Countries | Which ones | 

 Europe | 41 | Albania, Andorra, Austria, Belarus, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Monaco, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Ukraine, United Kingdom, Vatican City | 
CIS and the Caucasus | 4 | Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan | 
Asia and Oceania | 21 | Australia, Brunei, Cambodia, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Laos, Malaysia, Maldives, Mongolia, Myanmar, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Timor-Leste, Vietnam | 
Middle East and Africa | 19 | Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kenya, Kuwait, Mauritius, Morocco, Mozambique, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Rwanda, Saudi Arabia, Seychelles, South Africa, Tanzania, Tunisia, Türkiye, United Arab Emirates | 
The Americas | 12 | Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, Suriname, United States, Venezuela | 

 Source — the register of Visa on Arrival subjects on the Directorate General of Immigration portal. These registers change: they were revised twice in the past two years, so it is worth rechecking your passport before booking. A breakdown by nationality is on our visa by nationality page.

## Who will not be issued an eVOA

 Refusals are not only about nationality. There are three categories, and each outcome is known in advance.

 Nationals of countries outside the register. A visa on arrival is unavailable — an ordinary visa is arranged in advance instead, most often a C1 tourist visa through a sponsor.

 Holders of travel documents other than a passport. The e-visa portal names them outright: Laissez Passer, Titre de voyage, Travel Document, Document of Identity, Certificate of Identity, Alien Passport, Alien Travel Document, Emergency Travel Document, Emergency Passport and Temporary Passport. With a returning certificate or a temporary document the application cannot be filed.

 Stateless persons. The register is built around "nationals of country X", so stateless applicants fall outside it by definition.

 Not sure whether a restriction applies to you — message us before you book. Checking a passport takes a couple of minutes; being turned back at the border costs a flight.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: How many nationalities can get a visa on arrival in Indonesia?
As of August 2026, nationals of 97 countries, per the official register of the Directorate General of Immigration. The list is closed: if a country is not on it, an eVOA cannot be issued online or at the airport and a visa must be arranged in advance.

Вопрос: What if my country is not on the list?
You arrange a visa in advance. Most often that is a C1 tourist visa through a sponsor, which gives 60 days with two extensions up to 180.

Вопрос: Can I apply for an eVOA on a document other than a passport?
No. The e-visa portal explicitly lists the documents that cannot be used: Laissez Passer, Titre de voyage, Travel Document, Document of Identity, Certificate of Identity, Alien Passport, Alien Travel Document, Emergency Travel Document, Emergency Passport and Temporary Passport.

Вопрос: How is an eVOA different from an airport VOA?
It is the same visa. The eVOA is arranged online in advance — on arrival you go straight to passport control, skipping the payment counter. eVOA extensions can also be done online.

Вопрос: How do I extend a VOA?
One extension of 30 days is allowed. Start 1–2 weeks before the first period ends. We take the process over — in most cases with no in-person immigration visits.

Вопрос: What if 60 days is not enough?
Leave and return on a new visa — or arrange a C1 tourist visa (up to 180 days) or a multiple-entry D1/D2 in advance. A VOA cannot be converted to a long-stay visa inside the country.

Вопрос: Which airports accept it?
Any international airport and a number of seaports that accept foreign nationals — the visa is not tied to a city.

Вопрос: What does overstay cost?
1,000,000 IDR per day of overstay; up to 60 days it is paid at departure, beyond that serious immigration measures are possible.

 Cambodia requires a visa, and arranging it in advance beats getting it at the border: arrival queues and cash-in-dollars requirements are common.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: Is a visa required for Cambodia?

Вопрос: How much does it cost?
IDR 950,000 for the T tourist visa and IDR 1,000,000 for the E business visa. Both are valid for one month.

Вопрос: What is the difference between them?
How long you can stay afterwards. The T tourist visa is built for a month and extends only in a limited way; the E business visa extends inside the country for 3, 6 or 12 months, which is why people planning to stay take it.

Up to 5 working days.

# Visas to other countries from Indonesia

 01 · The real questionWill they take your fileSome consulates only deal with holders of a KITAS. Without one the application is refused at intake and the fee is not returned.

 02 · Good newsSome need no visa at allRussian citizens need no visa for China or South Korea. People still charge for both — do not pay.

 03 · WhereBali and JakartaSome centres sit on Bali, for others you fly. The difference in waiting time can be threefold.

 Updated: 27 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 You live in Bali and you are heading somewhere else — a holiday, family, work. The first question is not "which documents" but something simpler: will they accept an application here at all, given you are not an Indonesian citizen.
The answer varies widely by destination: some take applications from anywhere, some only from residents, and for some a visa is no longer needed at all.

## Where you can file from Indonesia

 Eight destinations, August 2026. Requirements as they apply to a foreigner living in Indonesia.
 Destination | Filing from Indonesia | KITAS required | Where | Timeline | 

 United Kingdom | yes, no conditions | not required | Jakarta, Bali, Surabaya | around 3 weeks | 

 Australia | yes, no conditions | not required | online | 13–35 days | 

 India | yes, online | not required | online, consulate in Bali | from 4 days | 

 Schengen | yes, with a condition | mandatory | Jakarta, Bali, Surabaya | 15 days by rule, often longer | 

 United States | yes, with a condition | mandatory | Jakarta, Surabaya | 2 weeks to 1.5 months | 

 Japan | yes, with a condition | mandatory | Denpasar, Jakarta | 5 working days | 

 China | no visa needed | — | visa-free until 31.12.2027 | — | 

 South Korea | no visa needed | — | visa-free, 60 days | — |

 The China and Korea rows apply to Russian citizens. Other passports have different terms — tell us yours and we will check.

## What you should not be paying for

 Starting with what saves you money today. Two destinations are sold as a service although no visa is required.

 ✓China. The unilateral visa waiver for Russian citizens has run since September 2025 and was extended to 31 December 2027 — notice from the Chinese foreign ministry dated 20 May 2026. Ordinary passport, up to 30 days, for tourism, business, family visits and transit. Yet agencies still write that no waiver exists and offer a transit workaround.

 ✓South Korea. The visa waiver agreement with Russia has been in force since January 2014, 60 days. No visa is needed — only the K-ETA electronic authorisation. Korean visas are nonetheless sold for sums around four million rupiah.

 ✓India. The 30-day electronic visa has been free for Russian citizens since 1 January 2026. The form takes a quarter of an hour. The only thing worth paying for is having it checked before submission: refusals over a typo in a passport number are routine.

 We say this plainly even though it shrinks our own price list. Selling someone a visa they do not need is a poor way to build a relationship with a client who will come back to us for a KITAS.

## Where they will not take you without a KITAS

 Three destinations deal only with people legally resident in Indonesia. This is a written rule, not an official's whim.

 SchengenThe EU Visa Code requires filing with the consulate of the country where you are legally resident. The visa centre in Indonesia accepts foreigners holding a valid KITAS or KITAP. Without one an application can be declared inadmissible, and the fee is not refunded.

 United StatesThe appointment system explicitly offers a "citizen or resident of Indonesia" category, where the KITAS and KITAP are named as proof. A non-resident can formally book, but lands in the worse queue, and the State Department itself warns that qualifying will be harder.

 JapanThe consulate general in Denpasar puts it directly: it accepts foreigners residing on a KITAS or KITAP, and does not accept those present on a short-stay visa — tourist, business or visa on arrival.

 The practical conclusion: if you plan to travel from Indonesia to Europe, the US or Japan, residence status pays for itself beyond its own merits. It opens consulates that will otherwise not talk to you.

## Traps nobody warns you about

 !The Netherlands does not accept tourist applications from Russian citizens living outside Russia — a KITAS does not override it. Only visits to close relatives and non-tourist purposes are allowed. The Netherlands was for years the best-trodden route from Bali, so people head there out of habit. A fee refused at intake is not returned.

 !Indonesia has no biometric collection centres for Australia. Filing is simple and entirely online, but if your application triggers a fingerprint request, the nearest centres are Singapore, Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok. The Australian side says as much: you may need to travel to another country. Budget for that risk in advance.

 !The Japanese fee rose fivefold. Since 1 July 2026 a single-entry visa costs IDR 1,650,000 against the previous 330,000. Some agencies still display the old figure.

 !For the US, Surabaya is roughly three times faster than Jakarta. On official waiting figures: Jakarta around a month and a half, Surabaya under half a month. The flight from Bali takes fifty minutes. Regulars know this; first-timers do not.

 !A UK visa costs more on Bali than in Jakarta. Intake in Jakarta is free; on Bali there is an additional charge of roughly £76. That is about the price of the flight — work out which suits you.

## What we actually do

 We do not promise a "guaranteed visa" — nobody can, and anyone promising it does not intend to answer for the outcome. What we do:

 ✓Check whether your documents will be accepted at all — before you pay the consular fee

 ✓Assemble the file for the specific consulate, not off a generic checklist

 ✓Book the appointment and tell you where the queue is shorter

 ✓Tell you honestly when your passport needs no visa at all

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: I hold a tourist visa, not a KITAS. Where can I still file?
The United Kingdom, Australia and India — none of them imposes a residence requirement. For Schengen, the US and Japan, filing without residence status is not worth attempting: at best the file is refused at intake, at worst accepted and refused on the merits, and the consular fee is lost either way.

Вопрос: How long must my KITAS be valid at the time of filing?
The widely repeated "at least six months" requirement appears in no official source we could find. What actually matters is that the status covers your travel dates and ideally remains valid for some time after your return — the consulate wants to see that you have somewhere to come back to.

Вопрос: Is it true that Russian citizens are not being granted visas right now?
They are, but conditions have tightened and differ by country. Some restrictions run on nationality and residence does not override them — Dutch tourist applications, for instance. Elsewhere it is business as usual: Japan on Bali works from the standard checklist, the only difference being two sets of forms instead of one. This has to be checked country by country, not by general mood.

Вопрос: What about consular fees?
They change, sometimes sharply: the Japanese fee rose fivefold in July 2026. So we quote the amount on the day of filing rather than lifting a figure from last year's article. For the US, keep in mind that an additional fee exists in US legislation which is not yet charged in Indonesia but could be switched on.

Вопрос: Can I file in a country where I neither live nor hold citizenship?
Formally possible in some cases, but practically the worst option available. For Schengen the rules explicitly name "a long queue at home" as an insufficient reason to file in a third country. The deeper problem is different: you end up having to prove ties to two countries at once — your country of citizenship and your country of residence. A typical refusal reads exactly that way: neither set of ties established.

## Tell us where you're going — we'll check whether they'll take your file

 Name the country and your status in Indonesia. We answer before you pay the fee, and we say plainly when you need no visa at all.

# Japanese visa from Indonesia

 01 · WhereDenpasarA rare case: filing happens on Bali, with no flight needed.

 Japan is the only high-value destination filed directly on Bali: the consulate operates in Denpasar. It also has the shortest processing time of any route — five working days.
In exchange it requires a KITAS and a detailed day-by-day itinerary.

At the consulate in Denpasar — a rare case where no trip to Jakarta is needed. Filing in Jakarta is also possible if that suits you better.

Вопрос: Is a KITAS required?
Yes, mandatory. Without a residence permit a foreigner’s application will not be accepted in Indonesia.

Вопрос: How long does it take?
Five working days — the shortest processing time of any destination filed from Indonesia.

IDR 2,600,000 all-in. That is a market benchmark for August 2026; we confirm the exact amount on enquiry, because consulate tariffs change.

Passport, KITAS, proof of funds and a day-by-day itinerary with bookings. Japanese consulates read the itinerary closely — a vague plan is a common reason for documents being returned.

 Outbound visas · Schengen

# Schengen visa from Indonesia

 01 · Right to fileWhere you liveA KITAS lets you apply in Indonesia rather than your home country.
02 · FeeEUR 90Adult consular fee. We show it separately from our commission.
03 · Timing15 days by normApply 4–8 weeks ahead: the appointment queue is longer than processing.

 Updated: 28 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 A Schengen visa is filed where a person legally lives, not where they hold citizenship. For a KITAS holder that is Indonesia: documents are accepted in Jakarta, Bali and Surabaya, with no need to fly home.
We check your case before you pay the consular fee, assemble the file for the specific consulate and book the appointment.

## What is included and what is paid separately

 Schengen visa from Indonesia, August 2026.
 Item | Amount | Paid to | 

 Consular fee, adult | EUR 90 | the consulate, separately | 

 Consular fee, child 6–12 | EUR 45 | the consulate, separately | 

 Child under 6 | free | — | 

 Visa centre service fee | per the centre’s tariff | the visa centre, separately | 

 Our work: case check, document file, appointment | on request | us | 

 We show the consular fee separately from our commission on principle. When an agency quotes a single "all-in" figure, it usually hides both the fee and the markup, and there is no way to tell what you are paying for.

 Message us on WhatsAppMessage us on Telegram

## Where to file

 Visa centres accept applications in Jakarta, on Bali and in Surabaya. A KITAS is accepted as identification, and applications open no earlier than six months before the trip.

 The main-country rule. You file with the consulate of the country where you will spend the most days, and where the split is equal, the country of entry. This is where most applications come apart: the itinerary is built for one country while the trip is actually spent in another.

## What to prepare

 Passport plus KITAS or KITAP

 Flight and accommodation bookings for the whole route

 Medical insurance for EUR 30,000 covering the entire zone

 Proof of funds: recent bank statements

 Proof of employment or of your own business

 A consulate checklist and a checklist from the internet are different things. We assemble the file for the consulate you are actually filing with.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: Can I apply for a Schengen visa while living in Bali?
Yes. The application is filed where you legally reside, not where you hold citizenship. For a KITAS or KITAP holder that is Indonesia — flying to your home country is not required.

Вопрос: Is a KITAS required?
Yes, for Schengen it is mandatory. Without a residence permit the consulates in Indonesia will not accept a foreigner’s application, and the consular fee is not refunded if the application is not accepted.

Вопрос: How much is the consular fee?
EUR 90 for adults and EUR 45 for children aged 6 to 12; under 6 is free. The visa centre charges its own service fee on top. Our commission is billed separately from the consular fee — we always show them apart.

Вопрос: Where are documents accepted?
In Jakarta, Bali and Surabaya — visa centres operate in all three cities, and a KITAS is accepted as proof of identity.

Вопрос: How far ahead should I apply?
Four to eight weeks before the trip. The processing norm is 15 days, but in summer and around holidays the queue for an appointment stretches more than the processing itself.

Вопрос: Will I get a multiple-entry visa?
Most likely not. Residents of Indonesia are usually issued a single-entry visa for a specific trip, so plan around that rather than around hopes of a multi-entry.

## How it runs

 We assess the casePurpose of travel, visa history and ties to where you live. We say honestly when the odds are poor.

 Form and feeWe complete the DS-160 and pay the consular fee — booking only opens after that.

 Slot and preparationWe book a workable date and go through the interview questions and the documents worth bringing.

 The interviewIn person in Jakarta or Surabaya. The decision is given on the spot and the passport is kept for printing.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: Can I apply for a US visa while living in Bali?
Yes. A US visa is filed where it suits you to attend the interview, not by citizenship. Indonesia accepts applications, and living here is not strictly required, though residence helps with appointment slots.

Вопрос: Where does the interview take place?
At the embassy in Jakarta or the consulate in Surabaya. There is no US consulate on Bali, only occasional outreach sessions, so plan for the flight.

Вопрос: How much is the consular fee?
USD 185 at the time of writing, with an increase to USD 435 under discussion. The fee is paid before booking and is not refunded on refusal. Our commission is billed separately.

Вопрос: Is a KITAS required?
Not formally — you can book without one. But residents get priority on slots, and a residence permit strengthens the application by showing ties to where you live.

Вопрос: Can the interview be done online?
No. Attendance in person is mandatory.

Вопрос: What language is the interview in?
English. An interpreter is possible, but their admission is agreed in advance rather than settled on the day.

## How to choose: three questions

 Your visa is decided by duration, purpose and plans. Up to 60 days — the eVOA; a 3–6-month season — the C1 or C2 with extensions; living between two countries — a multiple-entry D1/D2; business scouting — the D12; remote work — the E33G KITAS; relocating for good — a KITAS for your situation and later the KITAP. The full decision route with a 30-second cheat sheet is in our visa selection guide; how each status extends — in the extension guide.

 Two money-saving rules: since June 2025 every extension requires in-person biometrics at an immigration office, and overstaying costs IDR 1,000,000 per day per person. File at least 7–10 working days before your permit ends.

## FAQ

Вопрос: Which visa should a first-time visitor start with?
The eVOA: 30 days plus one 30-day extension. Applied for online before the flight, no sponsor needed.

Вопрос: Can I switch to another visa without leaving?
A visit visa cannot be swapped for another visit visa in-country. Moving to a KITAS, however, is processed onshore, with the Bridging Visa covering the gap.

Вопрос: What is the maximum stay without residency?
Up to 180 consecutive days on a C1 or C2 with two extensions. Anything longer means a residence status — a KITAS matching your situation.

Вопрос: What works best for frequent arrivals?
A multiple-entry D1/D2 for 1–2 years: every entry grants 60 extendable days, with no new visa per trip.

Home/Visas to Indonesia/Work KITAS

 Visa Service · Residence + work

# Work KITAS E23

 01 · RightsWork + residenceThe only way to be legally employed in Indonesia.
02 · SponsorThe employing companyThe KITAS is issued on the back of permits obtained by the employer.
03 · FamilyKITAS for loved onesDependent KITAS for a spouse and children attach to your work permit.

 Updated: 27 August 2026 · Verified by the Malina Visa team

 A Work KITAS bundles a work permit with a residence permit. It is the only route to legal employment with an Indonesian company: no other visa grants the right to work or earn income in the country.
The employer acts as sponsor: the company first obtains approval to hire a foreign employee (RPTKA) and related permits, then an entry visa (VITAS) is issued and converted into a KITAS after arrival, with mandatory biometrics. Duration depends on the position — typically 6 to 12 months, renewable.

## Key terms
Permits work only for the sponsoring company
Term — usually 6–12 months, defined by the position; renewable
Requires employer-side permits (RPTKA and related documents)
Entry on a VITAS converted to a KITAS after arrival; biometrics mandatory
Dependent (family) KITAS available for a spouse and children
Note: changing employers means redoing the permits and the KITAS — freelancing or side work for other companies is not allowed on a Work KITAS.

## Required documents
A passport with generous remaining validity
A personal photo
Diploma/qualification proof and a CV — matched to the position’s requirements
Employer company documents — we assemble these with their team
We prepare both sides of the process: the employee package and the employer permits.

## Pricing and timing

 Work KITAS E23, August 2026. Our all-in prices, in IDR.
 How we file | KITAS validity | All-in price | DKP-TKA state levy | Processing time | 

 Offshore — you are outside Indonesia | 1 year | 17,000,000 | USD 1,200 | 30–45 business days | 

 Onshore — you are already here, via a bridging visa | 1 year | 21,000,000 | USD 1,200 | 30–45 business days after the bridging visa | 

 DKP-TKA (Dana Kompensasi Penggunaan Tenaga Kerja Asing) is the state compensation levy for employing a foreign worker: USD 100 per month, so USD 1,200 for a year, paid upfront at filing. Older sources call it DPKK. The employer pays it and it is not part of our price. Do not confuse it with RPTKA — that is not a payment but the foreign worker utilisation plan approved by the Ministry of Manpower.

 The 4,000,000 IDR difference is the bridging visa, the interim status for switching to a KITAS without leaving the country.

 A work KITAS takes longer than any other: the RPTKA approval at the Ministry of Manpower accounts for most of the wait. Plan your start date with room to spare.

DeliveryThe finished document arrives with a notification and stays in your personal account.

## Frequently asked questions

Вопрос: Can I work for several companies?
No — a Work KITAS is tied to a specific employer and position. Working for other companies requires separate authorisation.

Вопрос: What happens if I change jobs?
The new employer goes through the process anew: their own permits and a new KITAS. We help make the transition without gaps in legal status.

Вопрос: Can my family move with me?
Yes — dependent KITAS for your spouse and children attach to your work permit. They cannot work on it, but living and schooling are covered.

Вопрос: How fast is a Work KITAS issued?
Slower than regular visas: employer permits first, then the VITAS and conversion. Exact timing depends on the position and the company’s paperwork — we’ll give a realistic estimate after a consultation.

Вопрос: What about permanent residence?
After several years of continuous Work KITAS (typically five) you may qualify for a KITAP — permanent residence.

Главная/Визы в Индонезию/EPO

 Закрытие статуса · EPO

# Закрытие КИТАС EPO

 01 · Для когоВы в ИндонезииПроцедура для тех, кто ещё находится в стране.
02 · Цена1 500 000 IDRПод ключ. Столько же стоит ERP для уехавших.
03 · После7 дней на вылетУспеть нужно в этот срок, дальше просрочка.

 Обновлено: 28 августа 2026 · Проверено командой Malina Visa

 EPO (Exit Permit Only, «разрешение только на выезд») — процедура закрытия КИТАС для тех, кто ещё находится в Индонезии. Иммиграция аннулирует статус и даёт окно на вылет.
Под ключ — 1 500 000 IDR. Если вы уже улетели, а КИТАС остался открытым, вам нужна другая процедура — ERP.

## Как это устроено

 Закрытие КИТАС: EPO и ERP, август 2026.
 Процедура | Где вы находитесь | Что происходит | Цена под ключ | 

 EPO | в Индонезии | КИТАС аннулируется, семь дней на вылет | 1 500 000 IDR | 

 ERP | за пределами страны | КИТАС закрывается дистанционно | 1 500 000 IDR | 

 Разница только в том, где вы физически находитесь в момент подачи. Цена одинаковая.

 Закрыть КИТАС через WhatsAppНаписать в Telegram

## Что нужно знать до подачи

 Семь дней на вылет после оформления — дальше начинается просрочка

 Паспорт сдаётся в иммиграцию физически — пока идёт процедура, лететь никуда нельзя

 КИТАС аннулируется сразу — вернуться по нему не получится, для въезда нужна новая виза

 Делается и на истёкший КИТАС — просроченный статус закрывать надо, он не отваливается сам

 Не покупайте билет заранее. Сначала процедура, потом билет — а не наоборот. Пока паспорт в иммиграции, вылететь физически невозможно, а праздничные дни легко сдвигают сроки. Билет на послезавтра — самая частая причина нервов при закрытии КИТАС.

## Когда закрывать КИТАС обязательно

 Ситуаций больше, чем «уезжаю навсегда». Закрытие требуется каждый раз, когда прежний статус должен уступить место новому.

 Уезжаете из Индонезии насовсем — даже если у КИТАС осталось полгода срока

 Меняете тип КИТАС — например с E33G на инвесторский после открытия компании. Новый статус не выдадут, пока в системе висит старый

 Меняете работодателя — рабочий КИТАС не переносится от одной компании к другой

 Закрыли компанию-спонсора — ликвидация PT и закрытие связанных КИТАС идут в связке

## Почему КИТАС нельзя просто бросить

 Логика «срок кончится, и статус сам отвалится» не работает. Разрешение на пребывание живёт в базе иммиграции отдельно от вашего местонахождения, и закрыть его должен человек, а не календарь.

 Незакрытый КИТАС остаётся активным в системе, даже если вы улетели год назад

 Пока он активен, новую визу оформить нельзя — включая eVOA, на которую многие рассчитывают как на запасной вариант

 Спонсор остаётся формально связанным с вашим статусом, и вопросы придут в том числе к нему

## Что сделать до закрытия

 КИТАС тянет за собой хвост из привязанных вещей, и закрывать их удобнее, пока статус ещё действует: банковский счёт, договоры аренды, водительские права, регистрация по месту жительства. Скажите, что у вас открыто, — составим порядок действий.

## Частые вопросы

Вопрос: Сколько стоит EPO?
1 500 000 IDR под ключ. Столько же стоит ERP — процедура для тех, кто уже покинул страну.

Вопрос: Сколько времени на вылет после EPO?
Семь дней. Успеть нужно в этот срок, дальше начинается просрочка со штрафом 1 000 000 IDR в день.

Вопрос: Заберут ли паспорт?
Да, на время процедуры паспорт сдаётся в иммиграцию физически. Пока он там, вылететь невозможно — поэтому билет покупают после оформления, а не до.

Вопрос: Нужно ли закрывать КИТАС, если срок уже истёк?
Да. Это самое частое заблуждение: просроченный статус всё равно висит в базе иммиграции и мешает оформить новую визу. EPO делается и на истёкший КИТАС.

Вопрос: Можно ли вернуться в Индонезию после EPO?
По закрытому КИТАС — нет, он аннулируется. Для въезда нужна новая виза: eVOA, туристическая C1 или новый КИТАС.

Вопрос: Что будет, если просто улететь и не закрывать статус?
КИТАС останется активным в системе. Когда вы решите вернуться и подадитесь на новую визу — включая обычную eVOA, — выяснится, что старый статус не закрыт. Разбирать это задним числом дороже и дольше.
